questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: The Mount Fuji is in Japan.
A Mount Fuji is in Japan.
An Mount Fuji is in Japan.
questions.explanation: The names of individual mountains generally do not take 'the'.

questions.question: The Sahara is one of ___ largest deserts in the world.
questions.explanation: The Sahara is the established name of a desert and takes 'the'.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: The Asia is the largest continent.
An Asia is the largest continent.
A Asia is the largest continent.
questions.explanation: Names of continents generally do not take an article.

questions.question: They went trekking in ___ Alps during their holiday.
Which geographical name normally takes 'the'?
questions.explanation: Names of certain geographical regions and features containing descriptive common nouns often take 'the'.

questions.question: We spent our holiday in ___ Maldives.
questions.explanation: The Maldives is the conventional name of an island country and takes 'the'.

questions.question: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: The Lake Superior is very large.
A Lake Superior is very large.
An Lake Superior is very large.
questions.explanation: The names of individual lakes generally do not take 'the'.

questions.question: Choose the correct completion: ___ Europe has many historic cities.
questions.explanation: Names of continents, such as Europe, generally take no article.

questions.question: Which option is correctly written?
questions.explanation: An individual mountain with a proper name normally does not take 'the'.

questions.question: The hikers explored ___ Rocky Mountains.
questions.explanation: Names of mountain ranges generally take 'the'.

questions.question: Which sentence uses the article correctly?
options: Sri Lanka is an island nation in the Indian Ocean.
The Sri Lanka is an island nation in the Indian Ocean.
A Sri Lanka is an island nation in the Indian Ocean.
An Sri Lanka is an island nation in the Indian Ocean.
questions.correctAnswer: Sri Lanka is an island nation in the Indian Ocean.
questions.explanation: Most singular country names do not take 'the'.
